optionTrick.en: Use 2-yr factor $\frac{2809}{2500}$ or effective rate **12.36%** of 2,500 $\Rightarrow \mathbf{Rs.309}$!

Method 1: Ratio-Multiplier Method (53/50): 1) 6% annual factor $= \frac{53}{50}$ over 2 years $\Rightarrow \frac{2809}{2500}$.
2) $A = 2500 \times \frac{2809}{2500} = 2,809.00$.
3) $CI = 2,809.00 - 2,500 = 309.00$ (**₹309**).

Method 2: Effective 2-Yr Rate (2R + R²/100): Net 2-yr CI rate $= 12.36\%$. Multiply 0.1236 by 2,500 $\Rightarrow \mathbf{Rs.309}$!

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option A (**308**).
solution.keyConcept: Direct Simple Interest (SI = P × R × T / 100)

optionTrick.en: Effective interest rate $= 16\% \times 3.5 = 56\%$. Just take $56\%$ of 550 $= \mathbf{308}$!

steps.hi: मूलधन का $1\% = 5.5$। इसे $R \times T = 56$ से गुणा करें $= \mathbf{308}$!

solution.en:
Method 1: Standard SI Formula: 1) $P = 550$, $R = 16\%$, $T = 3.5$ year(s).
2) $SI = \frac{550 \times 16 \times 3.5}{100} = 5.5 \times 56 = \mathbf{308}$.

Method 2: 1% Base × (R × T) Mental Trick: $1\%$ of Principal $= 5.5$. Multiply by $R \times T = 56$: $5.5 \times 56 = \mathbf{308}$.
solution.hi:
विधि 1: मानक साधारण ब्याज सूत्र: 1) $P = 550$, दर $R = 16\%$, समय $T = 3.5$ वर्ष।
2) $SI = \frac{550 \times 16 \times 3.5}{100} = \mathbf{308}$ रुपये।

विधि 2: 1% मान × कुल प्रतिशत ट्रिक: मूलधन का $1\% = 5.5$। इसे $R \times T = 56$ से गुणा करें $= \mathbf{308}$!

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option D (**101 and 77**).

title.en: Method 1: Check Common Factors of All Pairs
title.hi: विधि 1: प्रत्येक युग्म का म.स. जाँच

steps.en: Spot digit sums ÷3 on Options A & C (`2+4=6, 5+1=6`; `9+6=15, 1+1+1=3`) and table of 7 on B (`63, 91`). D stays **101 and 77**!
steps.hi: विकल्प A व C दोनों 3 से कटते हैं, B `7` के पहाड़े में है — बिना हल **101 and 77**!

solution.en:
Method 1: Check Common Factors of All Pairs: 1) $\text{HCF}(24, 51) = 3$.
2) $\text{HCF}(63, 91) = 7$.
3) $\text{HCF}(96, 111) = 3$.
4) $77 = 7 \times 11$ and prime 101 have $\text{HCF} = 1 \Rightarrow$ **101 and 77**.

Method 2: Cast-Out-3s & Prime Recognition (4 sec): Spot digit sums ÷3 on Options A & C (`2+4=6, 5+1=6`; `9+6=15, 1+1+1=3`) and table of 7 on B (`63, 91`). D stays **101 and 77**!
solution.hi:
विधि 1: प्रत्येक युग्म का म.स. जाँच: 1) `24 व 51` (3 से विभाज्य), `63 व 91` (7 से विभाज्य), `96 व 111` (3 से विभाज्य)।
2) `101` एक अभाज्य संख्या है जो `77 (7×11)` को नहीं काटती $\Rightarrow \text{म.स.} = 1$ $\Rightarrow$ **101 and 77**।

विधि 2: 3 नियम व अभाज्य पहचान: विकल्प A व C दोनों 3 से कटते हैं, B `7` के पहाड़े में है — बिना हल **101 and 77**!

topic: Laws of Indices • RRB Group D Level-1 (12 Aug 2026 Shift 24)

question.en: Given that 27 0.48 = x, 27 0.86 = y and x z = y 10 , then the value of z is close to:
question.hi: यदि दिया गया है कि 27 0.48 = x, 27 0.86 = y और x z = y 10 है , तो z का सन्निकट मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

solution.approach: Verified Answer: **17.92** ($z = 17.9167 \approx 17.92$).
solution.keyConcept: Same Base Power Law: B^{p·z} = B^{q·k} ⇒ z = (q × k) / p

optionTrick.en: Ignore dummy base 27! Directly equate exponents: $0.48z = 0.86 \times 10 = 8.60 \Rightarrow z = 8.60 / 0.48 \approx 17.92$.
optionTrick.hi: डमी आधार 27 को छोड़ें! सीधे घात बराबर करें: $0.48z = 0.86 \times 10 \Rightarrow z \approx 17.92$।

title.hi: विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना

title.en: Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`)

solution.en:
Method 1: Base Substitution & Exponent Equating: Substitute $x = 27^{0.48}$ and $y = 27^{0.86}$ into $x^z = y^{10}$:
$27^{0.48z} = 27^{0.86 \times 10} = 27^{8.60}$.
Since bases are equal, $0.48z = 8.60 \Rightarrow z = \frac{8.60}{0.48} = 17.9167 \approx \mathbf{17.92}$.

Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`): Ratio of exponents $0.86 : 0.48 = 43 : 24$ ⇒ $z = \frac{43 \times 10}{24} = 430/24 \approx \mathbf{17.92}$.
solution.hi:
विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना: $x = 27^{0.48}$ व $y = 27^{0.86}$ को $x^z = y^{10}$ में रखें:
$27^{0.48z} = 27^{8.60} \Rightarrow 0.48z = 8.60 \Rightarrow z \approx \mathbf{17.92}$।

विधि 2: सीधा अनुपात सूत्र (`4 सेकंड`): सीधा $z = \frac{0.86 \times 10}{0.48} \approx \mathbf{17.92}$।

question.en: The income of Raman is ₹68,500. He saves 22.5% of his income. If his income increases by 14% and expenditure increases by 40%, then his savings will:
question.hi: रमन की आय ₹68,500 है। वह अपनी आय के 22.5% की बचत करता है। यदि उसकी आय में 14% की वृद्धि होती है और व्यय में 40% की वृद्धि होती है , तो उसकी बचत में _______ होगी।

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option D (**decrease by ₹11,645**).
solution.keyConcept: Direct Change Law: ΔSavings = ΔIncome − ΔExpenditure

optionTrick.en: Notice net $\%$ change in income = $+14\%$, while expenditure change on whole income = $-\frac{77.5}{100} \times 40\%$. That gives direct Net Factor $= -17\%$ of ₹68,500 $= \mathbf{Rs.11,645}$!

trapAlert.en: Never waste 60 seconds calculating New Income and New Expenditure first! Only compute ΔI and ΔE and take ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (positive = increase, negative = decrease).
trapAlert.hi: पुरानी-नई आय अलग से निकालकर 60 सेकंड बर्बाद न करें; सीधे $\Delta\text{बचत} = \Delta\text{आय} - \Delta\text{व्यय}$ सूत्र से चिह्न (+ वृद्धि / − कमी) तय करें।

title.en: Method 2: Smart ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (12 sec)
title.hi: विधि 2: स्मार्ट Δबचत = Δआय − Δव्यय ट्रिक

solution.en:
Method 1: Basic Income-Expenditure Table: 1) Old Savings $= 22.5\%$ of ₹68,500 = **₹15,412.5**; Old Expenditure $= 77.5\%$ of ₹68,500 = **₹53,087.5**.
2) New Income ($+14\%$) = **₹78,090**; New Expenditure ($+40\%$) = **₹74,322.5**.
3) New Savings $= Rs.78,090 - Rs.74,322.5 = Rs.3,767.5$.
4) Change $= Rs.3,767.5 - Rs.15,412.5 \Rightarrow$ **Decrease of ₹11,645**.

Method 2: Smart ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (12 sec): 1) $\Delta I = +14\%$ of ₹68,500 = **+₹9,590**.
2) $E = 77.5\% \times Rs.68,500 = Rs.53,087.5$, so $\Delta E = +40\% \times Rs.53,087.5 = +Rs.21,235$.
3) $\Delta S = Rs.9,590 - Rs.21,235 = -Rs.11,645 \Rightarrow$ **Decrease by ₹11,645**.
